description: Three separate one-into-three multiples in 6HP, stacked so that an unpatched input takes the signal from the group above it

inputs.text: The signal copied to the first group of three outputs; nothing is added to it and nothing is taken away
The signal copied to the second group of three outputs; with nothing patched here the group follows the first input instead, one sample late
The signal copied to the third group of three outputs; with nothing patched here the group follows the second input instead, one sample late

outputs.text: A copy of the first input, at the voltage it arrived at
A copy of the first input; this is also the voltage the second input reads when nothing is patched into it
A copy of the second input, at the voltage it arrived at
A copy of the second input; this is also the voltage the third input reads when nothing is patched into it
A copy of the third input, at the voltage it arrived at

notes: the panel prints a dotted line from the last output of a group down to the input below it. That line is the normal: pull the lower cable out and the group follows the one above.
the normal is read from the output jack rather than from the input, so a group fed by the normal runs one sample behind the group above it.
the lamp beside each input glows red for negative voltage and blue for positive, reaching full at 5V either way, and is smoothed so it lags a fast signal.
the module is monophonic: every jack carries one channel.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the first input, one sample late.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the second input, one sample late.
